nodes.label: agent: serialized streaming chat loop
nodes.rationale: Only chat uses an open-ended tool loop, capped at ten rounds. A turn shares one undo batch, persists successful earlier writes after later tool failures, and finishes even if its client leaves.

nodes.label: cleanup: durable capture followed by structured extraction
nodes.norm_label: cleanup: durable capture followed by structured extraction
nodes.rationale: Raw input is saved before a light-model call, so capture remains usable without a provider. Cleanup applies its changes as one undoable batch and merges only exact ticket-key matches to avoid silently swallowing notes.

nodes.label: facts: pure constraint and annotation functions
nodes.norm_label: facts: pure constraint and annotation functions

nodes.label: llm: Anthropic and OpenAI-compatible provider interface
nodes.norm_label: llm: anthropic and openai-compatible provider interface

nodes.label: planner: versioned plans and current-state task picks
nodes.norm_label: planner: versioned plans and current-state task picks
nodes.rationale: Plans remain stable until a defined replan trigger; What now considers all currently eligible tasks. Invalid structured replies get one retry, while provider failure or timeout uses deterministic fallback ordering.

nodes.label: prompt: ordered persona and live-context layers
nodes.norm_label: prompt: ordered persona and live-context layers
nodes.rationale: Core instructions precede style, about-me text, and live context to preserve instruction precedence and a cacheable stable prefix. Style affects tone only.

nodes.label: service: sole write path and batch undo
nodes.norm_label: service: sole write path and batch undo
nodes.rationale: REST handlers and agent tools share writes, activity snapshots, batch assignment, and undo through one service boundary.

nodes.label: Rule-based llm.Client fake and prompt drift guard
nodes.norm_label: rule-based llm.client fake and prompt drift guard
nodes.rationale: Deterministic schema-specific replies allow exact assertions. Deliberate dependence on facts formatting makes prompt drift fail Go tests when cleanup or planning would otherwise silently fall back.

nodes.label: internal/app shared application wiring
nodes.rationale: app.Open constructs the store, service, hub, cleanup runner, planner, and agent for both serve and tui, preserving identical behavior and injectable client, clock, and location seams.

nodes.label: All tasks and shared task edit sheet
nodes.norm_label: all tasks and shared task edit sheet
nodes.rationale: Structured manual creation bypasses cleanup, preserves raw text as read-only when editing, and treats not-before edits separately from pushes so push counts retain their meaning.

nodes.label: Shared ritual triage and conflict reconciliation
nodes.norm_label: shared ritual triage and conflict reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Morning and wrap-up share suggested roll-over, push, and drop choices. A refreshed review preserves surviving choices after conflict; the triage list serves as confirmation because day start and wrap cannot be undone.

nodes.label: Fixed day-strip window and moving now marker
nodes.norm_label: fixed day-strip window and moving now marker
nodes.rationale: A window anchored at now pins the marker to the left edge. A window covering day start, events, current time, and end-of-day permits the marker to move and keeps the end-of-day label inside the strip.

nodes.label: Google Calendar secret-iCal integration
nodes.rationale: On-demand secret iCal feeds avoid OAuth verification and token-expiry burdens. go-ical and rrule-go handle feeds and recurrence; cached TZID locations avoid repeated disk reads. Errors name calendar labels without leaking secret addresses.

nodes.label: SyncEvents: idempotent event reconciliation and tombstones
nodes.norm_label: syncevents: idempotent event reconciliation and tombstones
nodes.rationale: UID plus original occurrence start preserves identity when meetings move. Keyed soft-deleted rows preserve user removals; pruning clears keys so returning events can reappear. Any failed source disables pruning because deduplicated rows do not retain calendar provenance.

nodes.label: Opt-in ticket picker and atomic Runner.Add
nodes.norm_label: opt-in ticket picker and atomic runner.add
nodes.rationale: Pulls offer unchecked tickets rather than making commitments. Add rechecks ref-key deduplication and creates one undoable user batch; clean tickets bypass model cleanup and remain one-time copies without Jira write-back.

nodes.label: Review Queue GET /api/queue ranked export
nodes.rationale: The proposed server endpoint loads saved preferences and uses the existing normalization, repository request, loading, and ranking pipeline so dismissals, penalties, estimates, and rereview signals match the queue UI.

nodes.label: Separate planner summary and user reflection
nodes.norm_label: separate planner summary and user reflection
nodes.rationale: The planner keeps factual third-person notes while the user receives a short second-person reflection in their assistant's style. Reflection derives only from the summary so both texts share one factual source.

nodes.label: Bubble Tea terminal companion
nodes.rationale: The terminal companion calls Go services directly and handles daily quick actions and chat. Settings and wrap-up stay in the browser; Bubble Tea, Bubbles, and Lip Gloss remain on the v1 package family for teatest compatibility.

nodes.label: Web morning and evening ritual pages
nodes.norm_label: web morning and evening ritual pages
nodes.rationale: Dedicated stepwise routes reduce morning overwhelm while keeping capture and collapsed chat available. Inline cards preserve distracting context, while a modal would block escape hatches.

nodes.label: Settings and persisted onboarding
nodes.rationale: Saved onboarding state works across browsers. Steps persist incrementally, and settings unmarshal over defaults so earlier installations inherit new fields.

nodes.label: TUI good-morning state machine
nodes.rationale: Explicit Enter starts the ritual so an overnight terminal never initiates a main-model review unasked. Capture precedes cleanup and planning; conflicts retain choices and clear already-saved dumps to prevent duplication.

nodes.label: Compiled integration contract and Runner
nodes.rationale: Integrations are compiled Go packages with declarative fields and storage-independent pull results. app.Open injects integrations into Runner to avoid a contract-to-implementation import cycle; a process boundary would add no external interoperability.

nodes.label: Jira ticket integration
nodes.rationale: User-authored JQL provides adaptable selection without company-specific defaults. A PAT-authenticated search returns at most fifty issues, assigned issues first, with a count of additional matches.

nodes.label: Review Queue ticket integration
nodes.rationale: The integration preserves upstream ranking, applies an optional raw minimum score, caps results at fifty, and reuses the generic ticket picker. Raw scores distinguish requested reviews from bot work better than broad score bands.

nodes.label: Code establishes facts; the LLM makes judgments
nodes.norm_label: code establishes facts; the llm makes judgments
nodes.rationale: Deterministic code computes constraints and annotations while the model decides ordering, tiers, pacing, and emotional interpretation. Validation rejects impossibilities rather than filtering away contextual evidence.

nodes.label: BatchApplied source selects undo affordances
nodes.rationale: A stored actor cannot distinguish cleanup from chat, and response timing and other tabs prevent reliable inference. An event-only source field identifies user, chat, cleanup, or triage without a schema change.

nodes.label: Debounced refetch on SSE events
nodes.rationale: The server is authoritative. Batch and plan events trigger debounced snapshot refreshes rather than local patches; reconnect also reloads chat and clears potentially lost work indicators.

nodes.label: e2e build tag isolates keys and substitutes clients
nodes.norm_label: e2e build tag isolates keys and substitutes clients
nodes.rationale: Tagged initialization mocks the keychain, removes provider environment keys, and wraps the real settings client factory. Building and launching in one command prevents resets from reaching a real keychain through an untagged binary.

nodes.label: Process-local reflection lazy fill
nodes.rationale: Today backfills wrapped days with summaries but no reflection asynchronously. Per-day exclusion prevents duplicate calls within a process; failed fills wait for process restart to avoid repeated failing model requests on every reload.

nodes.label: Process-local hub plus five-second snapshot reload
nodes.norm_label: process-local hub plus five-second snapshot reload
nodes.rationale: Separate processes can share WAL-mode SQLite but do not share hub messages. Timed TUI reloads recover external changes; same-process web serving shares the hub, while each cleanup runner handles only its own captures.

nodes.label: Rereview-aware open-versus-closed deduplication
nodes.rationale: A re-request is new work even when an earlier task was done or dropped. Open refs and skips always suppress tickets; closed refs suppress only tickets without Rereview. Pull and Add share the rule, and the flag survives the client round trip.

nodes.label: Isolated demo database and port
nodes.rationale: Run the demonstration against .demo/whatnow.db on port 7778 to leave real data untouched and allow checkpoint restoration.

nodes.label: Manually advanced demo clock
nodes.rationale: Compress a whole day into ten minutes; discard skipped nudges to avoid a notification burst.

nodes.rationale: Keep the service on loopback and expose it through Tailscale Serve with an allowed hostname; reachable allowed hosts receive full access.

nodes.label: Terminal UI companion
nodes.rationale: Sit in a spare terminal pane throughout the day while web-only setup, settings, wrap-up, nudges, and detailed editing remain in the browser.

nodes.rationale: Provide an ADHD-oriented day planner that adapts tasks and events to energy instead of enforcing an hourly schedule.

nodes.label: Personalized energy and hard-stop constraints
nodes.rationale: Put demanding work before lunch, lighter tasks after meetings and after 15:00, and constrain work by the school-pickup hard stop.

nodes.label: Must, Should, Could planning
nodes.rationale: Hold the day loosely by separating essential work, important work, and optional work.

nodes.label: Pre-paint persisted theme bootstrap
nodes.rationale: The head script reads whatnow-theme from localStorage and sets the document theme before first paint. Its comment explicitly couples this copy to lib/theme.ts.

nodes.label: Single Go binary with embedded static SvelteKit frontend
nodes.norm_label: single go binary with embedded static sveltekit frontend
nodes.rationale: Pure-Go SQLite avoids cgo; embedded frontend assets simplify local distribution. A Homebrew formula supports services and avoids the unsigned-download quarantine behavior described for casks.

nodes.label: Static frontend build and SPA fallback
nodes.norm_label: static frontend build and spa fallback
nodes.rationale: adapter-static output is copied into internal/web/dist and embedded. A committed placeholder permits Go builds without Node; empty assets produce a build instruction, and non-API routes fall back to 200.html.

nodes.label: Declarative integration fields and isolated secret storage
nodes.norm_label: declarative integration fields and isolated secret storage
nodes.rationale: Integration JSON lives outside the whole-document general settings to prevent stale saves overwriting skips. Stable server-generated list-row IDs preserve keychain secret identity when labels change; resolved Config keeps implementations away from keychain access.

nodes.label: Transactional data reset and cross-tab reload
nodes.norm_label: transactional data reset and cross-tab reload
nodes.rationale: Discovering tables through sqlite_master makes reset include future tables automatically. Key deletion and data.reset accompany the database wipe, bringing open tabs back to onboarding.

nodes.label: Pure nudge calculation and server-clock firing window
nodes.norm_label: pure nudge calculation and server-clock firing window
nodes.rationale: A lastTick < at <= now window catches throttled intervals without replaying old nudges on reload. Clock jumps adjust the window, notification tags collapse duplicate tabs, and the model runs only when an event-end nudge is clicked.

nodes.label: Documented Svelte MCP discovery and validation workflow
nodes.norm_label: documented svelte mcp discovery and validation workflow
nodes.rationale: The corpus file prescribes section discovery, relevant documentation retrieval, and repeated autofixing for Svelte authoring; Playground links require confirmation and are excluded for code written into project files.
